# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/coliff/image-optimizer-app/releases/latest) receives security fixes.
Installed copies update themselves on their next launch, so keeping the app up to date is usually all you need to do.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue for a security problem.
Instead, report it privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/coliff/image-optimizer-app/security/advisories/new)
(the **Report a vulnerability** button on the repository's **Security** tab).

Include what you found, the version you tested and the steps or a sample file that reproduces it.
You'll get a reply as soon as possible, and you'll be credited in the advisory once a fix is released unless you'd rather not be.

## Bundled tools

Image Optimizer ships third-party optimizers (listed in [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)).
If the problem is in one of those tools rather than in Image Optimizer itself, please also report it to that project.
